## Description

Show today's schedule read-only, labelled "as of <time>", when the network drops, from a per-user encrypted cache that expires after 12 hours and is wiped on sign-out or deactivation. No search; create, edit and cancel stay disabled. Requires an ADR (what may be stored in the browser, key handling) before any code; not to be built unless pilots show the printed day sheet is not enough.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** An ADR records what is stored, how it is keyed and why, and is accepted before implementation.
- [ ] **AC2.** During an outage the schedule is shown read-only with an "as of" label and create, edit and cancel are disabled.
- [ ] **AC3.** The cache is deleted on sign-out, after 12 hours and when the account is deactivated.
- [ ] **AC4.** Inspecting the browser store shows only ciphertext, and the test fails if the encryption is removed (mutation check).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
